每日计划

    听力练习

    原创练习 · 合成朗读

    Why did the library extend the laptop loan period?
    A. Students needed laptops for weekend projects.
    B. The library closed on Friday afternoons.
    C. More laptops became available.

    查看答案和原文

    答案 A。学生需要把电脑带走，以便在周末完成项目。

    The university library began lending laptops last spring. At first, students could only use them inside the library. After students explained that they needed computers for weekend projects, the library extended the loan period to three days. Demand now peaks on Friday afternoons, so the library recommends making a reservation in advance.

    Why do the researchers collect temperature data at different times of day?

    查看参考答案

    他们希望比较树荫在一天中不同时段的降温效果，为决定在哪里种树提供依据。

    生词本

      写作

      原创练习 · 建议 30 分钟，150–200 词

      Should universities encourage students to take courses outside their major? Give reasons and examples to support your view.

      查看写作思路

      先表明立场，再分别论述跨学科学习的收益与时间成本，结合一个具体课程举例，最后回扣观点。

      翻译

      原创练习 · 中译英

      近年来，越来越多的城市把闲置空间改造成社区图书馆。居民可以在这里借书，也可以参加读书会。为了方便上班族，一些图书馆在周末和晚上开放。

      查看参考译文

      In recent years, a growing number of cities have turned unused spaces into community libraries. Residents can borrow books and join reading groups there. To make these services more accessible to working people, some libraries stay open on weekends and in the evenings.
